node_definition.done_when: Done when. A new test tests/test_the_pane_counts_reviews_under_r.py covers three cases. A fleet holding one working implementation and one working review counts 1w 1r . A delivered run with a live repair attempt counts as w , not d . The rendered row carries five right-aligned cells in the order w r n d q . At the base revision the first and second cases fail. The negative control drops the role split and fails the first case. The test files importing reckon/crew/ticker.py or reckon/crew/recovery_watch.py add no failure against the base, apart from literals that pin the four-cell width or letters, which change to the five-cell form and are named in the manifest. The arms run on the all_debug partition ( env -u SLURM_JOB_ID -u SLURM_JOBID sbatch --partition=all_debug ), one arm at a time with at most -n 4 . Each log is under the run directory, starts with its revision and the literal command, and ends in EXIT= . Ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the staged paths. Write paths: reckon/crew/recovery_watch.py , reckon/crew/ticker.py , skills/reckon-build/SKILL.md , the new test, and the test files whose four-cell literals change.
